column1: # i3 rows: `chord` is the bindsym key combination from i3/config/config, e.g.
# `$mod+Shift+Left`. Spelling is normalised before comparing ($mod/Mod4 → super,
# Mod1 → alt, Control → ctrl, case-insensitive, modifier order irrelevant), so
# write it however reads best. generate-wallpaper.sh cross-checks every
# default-mode binding in both directions: a chord listed here that is not
# bound, or a binding not listed here, fails the build. Submodes (resize,
# system) are described in the footer, not per key.
# EMACS-* rows are not checked. They come from github.com/fbielejec/emacs.d
# (customizations/*.el, only the files init.el actually loads), a separate
# repo that setup-emacs.sh fetches later in the run than this wallpaper step.
